opportunity: A callee's recovered prototype never reaches its callers. ActionDefaultParams reads a call's callee signature from the PrototypePieces parked on the callee's FunctionSymbol, and every writer of that slot is a DECLARED fact (a libc/libctypes table entry, DWARF, a demangled name, `parse line extern`, `--assert prototype`). Nothing parks what recovery found, so each caller types a call from its own local evidence: coreutils fmt -O2 renders the same two-parameter callee with one, two and three arguments inside main, and the FILE * the caller holds stops at the call.
status: Implemented. `protoorder off|types|lock`, DEFAULT `types`. `types` states the callee's recovered PARAMETER types as a vote at matching call arguments; the vote never sets a cast's required type and is refused wherever the caller holds contrary evidence (frame objects and frame memory, declared or global values, a different-class reader or writer, float disagreement, a float or composite pointee the caller's own loads and stores contradict, a value loaded through itself, a type deeper than the inferred pointer cap). The result vote is not stated. `lock` keeps the round-4 arity claim, opt-in.
test_name: 26 hermetic unit tests in p4_calls/kuna_protoorder/tests.rs (member lookup and strides among them); fourteen tests/cli probes over nine in-repo fixtures (protoorder_x86_64: off / default / arity pin / lock register-save decline; protoorder_stackarray_x86_64 and protoorder_stackstruct_x86_64, gcc -O0, a frame object that must stay whole; protoorder_codeptr_thumb_le32, a Thumb function address that must not print as &sub_8130[1]; protoorder_floatgpr_mipsel, MIPS o32, a float passed in a general register whose word the caller also uses as an integer; protoorder_floatstore_x86_64, a float stored beside an int; protoorder_floatreg_armhf.o, ARM hard-float values in s0 that keep the vote; protoorder_floatpointee_x86_64, gcc -O2, a union and struct copies written with integer bits through a pointer a callee reads as double *, struct P * and struct M *; protoorder_narrowvote_x86_64, gcc -O2, a caller storing eight constant bytes through the buffer it hands a callee whose recovered parameter is unsigned char *); kuna-cli tests jobs_output_is_byte_identical_to_serial, jobs_notes_that_the_default_callee_first_order_is_serial_only, jobs_run_workers_with_structsynth_off (serial reference with protoorder off), a_narrowed_run_orders_callees_first_only_when_asked, raw_image_discovers_called_functions_beyond_its_seeds, a_float_in_a_general_register_keeps_its_integer_uses_round_trip (seven MIPS callers compiled against a bit-preserving h), a_float_pointee_keeps_the_callers_integer_stores_round_trip (six x86-64 callers compiled from the default and the protoorder-off output and compared byte for byte with the source; all six differ on the pre-fix engine), a_byte_pointee_vote_keeps_the_callers_wide_stores (the default and --option ptrfromuse void keep fill's eight-byte store; both printed eight byte stores on the pre-fix engine)
inspiration: angr's Clinic propagates a recovered SimTypeFunction back onto the callee's Function.prototype, so later callers read it; Ghidra's decompiler-parameter-ID analyzer commits recovered prototypes to the program database before the callers are decompiled.

witness.note: the second parameter is the one the callee's own callees already proved is a string; with the option off nothing carries that across the call. Every call site renders the SAME arguments in both arms -- `sub_3700(v6)`, `sub_3700(stdin,v7)`, `sub_3700(stdin,"-",v10)` -- because `types` never moves an arity. The trailing fabricated argument at the third site is `argclobber`'s job, and the two compose: `--option argclobber on` alone gives 2/2/2 with `unsigned long a1`, and both on give 2/2/2 with `char *a1`.

fixture.caller_off: unsigned long caller(unsigned long a0,int a1)   /   caller(0x402000,3);
fixture.caller_types: unsigned long caller(unsigned char *a0,int a1)   /   caller((unsigned char *)0x402000,3);
fixture.arity_pins: thunk(a0,1,2,3,4) (one recovered parameter, five passed), sink(a0,a1) + overrec(v1), and vfmt((unsigned char *)0x402004) (six recovered parameters, one argument) all render identically in the off and types arms
fixture.lock_contrast: under `lock`, overrec's OWN signature becomes `void overrec(long *a0,unsigned long a1,long a2)` -- two parameters nothing sets -- and vfmt is declined outright by the register-file rule, so its one call site loses the pointer type `types` gives it

invariants_checked.float_votes: a float vote needs every other reader and writer of the value to be a float op, a copy of the bits (COPY/CAST/MULTIEQUAL/INDIRECT/LOAD), a float-class register of the calling convention, or a declared float: integer ops incl. SUBPIECE/PIECE, a STORE, and a RETURN/other call/call result outside a float register refuse it. Self-review sets over x86-64, MIPS o32, ARM softfp/soft/hard-float: the default differs from main only in int parameters from h(int k, ...) and bit-exact float literals
